title: Author an SEO keyword strategy for 'Cohort learning platform Kenya, Ghana and Nigeria'
description:
Build a targeted organic search keyword strategy mapping localized search intent across Nigeria, Kenya, and Ghana for cohort-based education platforms.

Include:
1. Target Keyword Clusters: High-intent terms around 'cohort learning platform', 'bootcamp community software', and 'virtual academy LMS' segmented by region (Lagos, Nairobi, Accra).
2. Intent & Volume Estimates: Search intent classification (Commercial vs Informational), free keyword volume benchmarks, and difficulty estimates.
3. Page Mapping Matrix: Assign each cluster to an existing or proposed Zedu route (/solutions/bootcamps, /pricing, or regional landing pages).
4. On-Page Optimization Guidelines: Proposed title tags, meta descriptions, and dynamic H1/H2 structures emphasizing Zedu's flat pricing and all-in-one cohort workspace.

Deliver a complete markdown plan in the attachment with verified citations from free keyword tools.
rationale: Expands Zedu's organic acquisition reach across primary African tech hubs outside and inside Nigeria, capturing cost-conscious bootcamp leads looking for modern cohort software.
